snippet.title: Xterium: Sci-Fi Space Strategy
snippet.description:
Google Play - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.xterium.xteriummobail
App Store - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/xterium/id1658549646


The exciting 4X RTS strategy online space game Xterium will take you on a journey through the Sci-Fi galaxy. This multiplayer MMO game offers a real-time open world with a wide variety of space fleets, planet types and different senators. Create your invincible empire!
Players of 4X strategy games explore expanse of space. They must expand their empire through careful strategy, exploit the resources of the galaxy, and exterminate hostile forces that threaten their dominion. 
EXPLORE
Xterium opens up a vast space world where each player can realize their ambitions and strategy in the galaxy. Whether you are a conqueror seeking to dominate the galaxy or a space explorer, your space journey will be up to you. In this vast cosmos, your strategy is the key to success! You need to think through every move to build an empire and succeed in a Sci-Fi galaxy.
EXPAND
The game Xterium gives you the opportunity to create your own space empire in the galaxy by developing each space planet and building your own civilization in the game. In the world of this strategy game, you decide how to develop military technology and build your own spaceships. There are 21 types of units, technology research and weapon improvements at your disposal to help you strengthen your empire. In the upgrade center, players improve their fleets and defenses by completing contracts and earning mods that they can use to install new types of combat weapons on their spaceship or add a dual-shot and shield module, depending on their strategy.
EXPLOIT
With a diverse army of spaceships at your disposal in the game, you will be able to control the vastness of space and expand your empire in the galaxy. Territory conquest is a dangerous but crucial part of the game. Colonizing star empires and strategy developing them under your control will be the key elements needed to expand your empire in the galaxy. This requires careful strategy and anticipation of possible attacks from space rangers and pirates.
EXTERMINATE
In the game Xterium you will have to compete with other emperors in a war for dominance of the universe. However, keep in mind that other Emperors and Space Rangers can declare war on you at any time. In such cases, you will have to quickly apply your online strategies in PvP battles to defend the galaxy and your empire in the vastness of the game.
You will have to fight for your survival against a variety of PvE enemies such as Barbarians, Pirates and Desolators roaming the space and threatening the galaxy. The choice of military strategy plays a crucial role in Star Wars. Destruction of infrastructure can cause significant economic and strategic losses to your empire. Pirates, in turn, can even threaten to destroy entire planets. You will have to carefully balance ambitions of conquest and defense to ensure the survival of your empire in a Sci-Fi galaxy.
COOPERATION
The Emperor in Xterium has the ability to strategy his empire in the galaxy, accumulating resources or directing them as support to allies and friends online. The game encourages players to actively interact with each other by providing opportunities to declare war, make alliances, join alliances, and trade resources to achieve their goals in the game. This approach increases the chances of survival and success in the galaxy. Cooperation allows you to use powerful weapons like the Death Star to destroy enemy planets. The strategy is yours to choose, but remember that Xterium is an open-ended world, and space warfare in the War of Alliances galaxy is always intense. 
Join players from around the world in this 4X multiplayer game and build your empire!
Download and play for free in Xterium War of Alliances - 4X RTS space strategy game!
